lines.text: Moses tells Israel that the LORD their God will cross the Jordan ahead of them as a consuming fire.
Moses stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, and God's finger inscribed the two stone tablets.
Moses came down the blazing mountain, saw the molten calf, and shattered the two tablets before the people's eyes.
Moses burned the calf and ground it to dust, and Israel rebelled when sent out from Beersheba.
Moses made an ark of cedar wood and placed the new tablets in it after the LORD wrote on them.
